description_en: Enables the multi-account management feature of Security Center
description_zh: 开通云安全中心多账号安全管理功能
name: EnableServiceAccessResourceDirectory

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder. The ID is an Alibaba Cloud account ID.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
